title: Browser: drag-and-drop (or file input) to open FLA in web build
description: In the web/browser build, the native Tauri file dialog isn't available. Add a browser-native open flow: (1) when File > Open is clicked in the browser, show a hidden <input type=file accept=.fla> and trigger a click on it; (2) also support drag-and-drop of .fla files onto the editor stage/window — attach a dragover/drop handler to the app root or stage area. On file selection/drop, read the file as ArrayBuffer and pass it to the existing loadFla() path. Check useFileActions.ts / Shell.tsx for where the Tauri open dialog is called and add the browser fallback.
